name: Lava Roll 2
author: gparnold
description:
My attempt at the Foundation ball rolling tutorial.
The path now gets steeper and the ball larger so rolls faster as the game progresses. Keys tilt the platforms left and right so you can guide the ball along the pathway. ‘A’ or left arrow tilt left, ‘D’ or right arrow tilt right. Unfortunately, the keys don’t seem to work in full screen mode!
